Canada’s unlikely trade war influencer fighting for the little guys
9 hours ago|
Duration

When U.S. President Donald Trump hit Canada with tariffs, Tod Maffin turned to social media. In conversation with The National’s Ian Hanomansing, the former broadcaster and culture commentator talks about becoming an unlikely patriotic influencer and why he thinks it’s time to unplug from American tech.
